sql:
SELECT
    p.PromotionCategory,
    sum(os.SalesAmount) AS discounted_online_revenue,
    avg(p.DiscountPercent) AS average_discount_percent
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS os
INNER JOIN retail.DimPromotion AS p
    ON os.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
WHERE os.DiscountAmount > 0
    AND p.PromotionCategory IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.PromotionCategory
ORDER BY discounted_online_revenue DESC, p.PromotionCategory ASC
